question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'went'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• while the boys (3)______ to school, 
 
• As the passage, is in the past tense hence, we need to use past tense or past verb in the given blank.
 
• So the correct answer is Option 1 i.e. went.

*Now the passage will be read as:- Long ago in China, at a time when girls (1) were__ expected to stay at home and **(2) **__**do**__ household work while the boys **(3) __went__** to school, a girl named Zhu had a desire (4)______ study. Her family was wealthy and Zhu was (5)______ so she too could have had her wish, but her father did not want to go against tradition.*
